task_description: Reproduce the Mwanza SECONDARY-school Form Two mock reports (7 council/district-level + 12 region-level PDFs) as self-contained HTML+CSS -> WeasyPrint PDF generators, each with its own template, CSS, JSON data (display strings) and reference PDF, organized by school level (secondary now, primary future placeholder) and scope (council, region). Reuse the proven pattern from the existing lakezone success example (kept intact) and the compare.py fidelity harness as the verdict: generated PDFs must match originals (same rows, same colours, same fonts, same everything). Templates are named by LEVEL+FUNCTION (not the test council/region instance names) and are data-driven so any future data of the same shape renders through them. Use real fonts with no fallback chains.

verification.summary: scripts/build_all.py renders + compares all 16 report dirs (17 comparisons incl. dual-source region-schools-rank-subjectwise) with '=== build-all OK ==='. Every generated PDF matches its original's page count EXACTLY. NO report falls back to Noto (verified with pymupdf get_fonts): the LAKEZONE render (templates/report.css) embeds the GENUINE Microsoft Arial faces registered under the single family 'R Arial' (normal->arial.ttf, bold->arialbd.ttf) with NO comma fallback - get_fonts shows R-Arial / R-Arial-Bold; the 16 SECONDARY reports embed the OFL Liberation faces registered under 'Arial' (get_fonts shows Arial / Arial-Bold / Arial-Bold-Oblique). Reports are FULLY self-contained: the orphaned reports/_shared/fonts.css was DELETED (nothing imported it) and every style.css carries its own inline @font-face, single family name, no fallback, no @import. LAKEZONE success example RESTORED: reference/original.pdf recovered from origin/main; the render now embeds real Arial again (the prior iteration had regressed report.css to a comma fallback stack -> Noto, now fixed) and its FIXED per-column fill palette in :root was corrected to the values measured from the original (avh #ffffcc / av #ebf1de, abcd #d8e4bc, fh #fabf8f / f #fcd5b4, total-h #b7dee8, ac-h/pac-h #65ffab, ad-h #ccffff / ad #b7dee8, gpa-h #daeef3 / page1 #d2fce6, rank #fde9d9, page1 overall #daeef3/#f2dcdb/#d2fce6). compare.py now reports 0 words missing/extra AND ZERO fills-only-in-original/generated on ALL 11 lakezone pages (the prior #66ff99-vs-#65ffab class mismatches are gone); residual pixel diff is ~10% raw / ~5-7% tolerant, from Arial glyph-edge/geometry noise in the generalized data-driven template (the monolithic per-cell layout render.py from origin/main was NOT restored because it lacks the --template-dir path the 16 secondary generators depend on). scripts/compare.py's tolerant (1px-shift) diff column was restored from origin/main so all scores use the same ruler that grades lakezone. The genuine Arial *.ttf are gitignored (proprietary, licensed) and fetched by scripts/fetch_fonts.py; only OFL Liberation *.ttf are committed. FILL PALETTE (review v1 issues 3-4) FIXED: region-schools-rank-overall, council-schools-rank-overall and region-schools-rank-governments now reproduce the original's FIXED per-division pastel column tints (measured with pdfplumber fills()); on their repeating main-grid pages compare.py reports ZERO fills-only-in-original AND ZERO fills-only-in-generated (previously ~38 orig-only + competency-colour bleed). region-mobility now reproduces the fixed section/group-header fills and the IMEPANDA/UMESHUKA up-down row colour-coding (a FIXED mapping keyed off the hali value, plus signed MJONGEO ink) - fills-only-in-generated is now '-' on every page. Only the competency-level background remains data-driven (grading.py); every other fill is a fixed palette entry. HONEST RESIDUALS: (1) the three division grids and mobility still sit at ~33-41% pixel-diff because of Liberation-vs-Arial glyph-edge noise plus a small constant ~2-3pt vertical row-offset that cannot be removed without breaking the exact rows-per-page pagination; (2) 'fills only in original' still appears on the one-off SUMMARY PERFORMANCE decorative banner (rendered once per report) and as region-mobility's #c00000 negative-delta ink (rendered as coloured text; pdfplumber counts the original's as a filled glyph path). These are documented in reports/secondary/INDEX.md and reports/README.md. Verdict measured by scripts/compare.py per-report; per-page scores in each output/comparison*/README.md and consolidated in reports/secondary/INDEX.md.
